derived_calculations: CNY 5.2910bn net receivables plus contract assets is up 8.26%, so it is neither at or below CNY 4.3985bn nor at or above the frozen 10% worsening threshold of CNY 5.3760bn.
The selected net-debt bridge is CNY 12.5874bn and the post-capex group cash proxy is positive CNY 1.5647bn; therefore neither the severe-block nor risk-worsens branch can match.
Risk-release cannot match because receivables did not decline at least 10%, regardless of the positive cash proxy.
cells.classification_reason: The first three frozen branches fail; complete comparable inputs instead show offsetting cash, receivable and debt directions. Strong core operations do not erase the group balance-sheet burden.

derived_calculations: The CNY 1.5647bn group cash proxy is positive, not negative by at least CNY 0.5bn, so neither adverse branch can match.
Receivables plus contract assets rose 8.26% and gross interest-bearing debt rose 7.10%, so favorable cash deleveraging cannot match even though the cash proxy exceeded CNY 0.5bn.
The cash balance also received CNY 1.2186bn of subsidiary NCI equity; that financing fact is not counted as owner cash or as operating collection performance.
cells.classification_reason: The complete inputs are mixed. Collection and post-capex cash improved, but receivables did not fall and gross debt rose. Government payment timing is kept external absent a controllable failure carrier.

local_unknowns: NCI is not below 10% on the balance-sheet claim boundary and is not otherwise closed by the annual report.

Although the parent received CNY 1.1729bn of investment-income cash, the annual report does not map all material subsidiary post-capex cash, required retention, NCI entitlements and distributable amounts into a complete parent-access bridge.
Absence of a documented upstream block is not evidence of unrestricted access to all positive group cash.
cells.classification_reason: Positive group cash and an observed parent receipt do not satisfy the frozen NCI and complete parent-access requirements; non-disclosure is localized rather than treated as adverse cash evidence.

local_unknowns: The NCI scope remains open: the annual report identifies the fund injection and group-level NCI, but does not close material-subsidiary post-capex cash and NCI entitlements.
Actual parent investment-income cash establishes some upstream access, not unrestricted access to the full positive group cash proxy.
Parent operating cash includes large intra-group flows and cannot be added to consolidated cash without an internal-elimination bridge.
cells.classification_reason: Neither favorable nor adverse attribution can be uniquely matched because the required NCI closure and full parent-access mapping are absent. The unknown is confined to owner-cash attribution.

derived_calculations: Attributable ex-nonrecurring profit of CNY 1.6254bn exceeds the favorable CNY 1.54775bn threshold.
Solid-waste operating net profit excluding engineering/equipment was reported as CNY 1.004bn and +9.64%, below the favorable CNY 1.0043bn and +10% requirements at issuer precision.
Neither adverse profit threshold is met; therefore the favorable and adverse branches both fail before the residual branch.
cells.classification_reason: Group recurring profit improved materially and solid-waste operations improved, but the frozen dual 10% favorable test is narrowly not met. External gas-price relief and identified revenue perimeter items are not converted into management credit.

local_unknowns: The authorized report does not disclose FY2023 same-boundary incineration gross margin for the frozen one-point comparison.
It does not disclose exact average gas procurement price, exact regulated/customer sale price, or a same-boundary FY2023 versus FY2024 energy recurring-profit bridge after persistent costs.
The current report-segment operating profit cannot be substituted for the required same-boundary recurring net-profit comparison.
cells.classification_reason: Incineration utilization and profit are favorable, but the favorable first branch also requires a same-boundary gross-margin comparison and durable energy economics when procurement price is no longer declining. Procurement cost did decline, and the exact energy price/profit bridge is unavailable. No responsibility-matched adverse carrier is observed, so the missing fields remain local rather than becoming a negative management inference.

excluded_inferences: No training utility, method utility or transfer validity inference is made.
No enterprise-final judgment, valuation, price, return, BuyBand, report or investment action is made.
External gas-price and government-payment timing are not automatically attributed to management.
Favorable waste-incineration performance is not used to erase group receivable, debt, restricted-asset or parent-access risk.
